articles.title: Proton Experimental gets fixes for Phantom Blade Zero, AION 2, The Forest and more
articles.summary: Valve released an early update to Proton Experimental to bring fixes for Windows games on Linux / SteamOS including Steam Deck, Steam Machine and Steam Frame.

articles.title: Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember
articles.summary: Introducing Our Smallest, Most Efficient Model: Muse Ember Meta AI just launched their entry in the Claude Haiku/GPT Luna category: Muse Ember, which they describe as: [...] our smallest and most efficient model designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing.

articles.title: JAMPACK’d Magazine – Issue #2
articles.summary: EposVox aka the Stream Professor has just opened pre-orders for the second issue of JAMPACK’d magazine – Physical media with a focus on 100% human-made, no-clickbait content.

articles.title: Have You Ever Heard Of the Lobo MAX-80?
articles.summary: [Adrian Black]’s enthusiasm is palpable as he shows off something truly unusual: a Lobo MAX-80 computer from 1982 . To call this machine rare would be an understatement, as the company folded soon after its release.

articles.title: 9to5Mac Daily: November 9, 2026 – Apple software development, iOS 28
articles.summary: Listen to a recap of the top stories of the day from 9to5Mac . 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes and Apple’s Podcasts app , Stitcher , TuneIn , Google Play , or through our dedicated RSS feed for Overcast and other podcast players.

articles.title: Mesa 26.3.0 arrives with many Linux graphics driver enhancements
articles.summary: While there's no announcement for it yet, the Mesa 26.3.0 open source drivers release is tagged and out now. Bringing many enhancements for gamers! We can see the release notes before they put them on the Mesa website thanks to their GitLab .

articles.title: Hacking the Sidekick in 2026
articles.summary: [ashe] ported a visual novel to their Sidekick 3 with their new key, saying “Endings arrive as real Sidekick text notifications, using an emulated modem.” Work continues on the Re:Danger server to bring other functionality back, including plans to spin up a GSM network to connect an actual Sidekick.

articles.title: Upcoming isometric action rogue-lite Everrest is "Hades meets EarthBound"
articles.summary: Everrest looks like one to stick onto your wishlist and keep an eye on, if you like the sound of "Hades meets EarthBound" as the developer tells me.

articles.title: Meta launches Muse Ember, a small AI model built for the repetitive work agents actually do
articles.summary: Meta has introduced Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient AI model to date. It's designed for the routine tasks AI agents handle all day: calling tools, handling small coding tasks, routing requests, extracting data, and processing long documents.

articles.title: OpenZ is an open-source 3D fan remake of the RTS 'Z' (The Bitmap Brothers, 1996)
articles.summary: In an email to GamingOnLinux they said: "We are the small team behind OpenZ, a free and open-source 3D remake of Z, the Bitmap Brothers real-time strategy game from 1996, made for its 30th anniversary.

articles.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
articles.summary: Meta Superintelligence Lab released a new AI model on Monday called Muse Ember, the lab’s lightest and most cost-efficient AI model yet. In its release, Meta said Ember was “designed for complex reasoning execution and the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing.”

articles.title: Claude Code v2.1.321
articles.summary: Added --settings <file> to claude remote-control , which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart claude remote-control.

articles.title: Samsung bets that you’ll either buy a Galaxy S27 Pro or Ultra next year
articles.summary: In this case, Samsung isn’t actually betting next year’s S27 Ultra is going to surpass its predecessor by record numbers; rather, this is all about adding the S27 Pro as a fourth model for consumers to pick from .

articles.title: Claude Fable 5.2 in GitHub Copilot
articles.summary: Claude Fable 5.2, Anthropic’s newest Fable model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot. You can use it for complex, multistep coding tasks across large codebases.

articles.title: Here's What Apple Fixed in iOS 27.2.1 and macOS 27.2.1
articles.summary: The iOS 27.2.1 , iPadOS 27.2.1, and macOS 27.2.1 updates Apple released today fix a handful of security vulnerabilities. With the security fixes implemented, it's a good idea to update as soon as you can.

articles.title: Don't Blame The Preferences: Examining The Emergence of Sycophancy in LLM Training
articles.summary: AI sycophancy, the tendency of large language models (LLMs) to flatter users and affirm their beliefs, can undermine accuracy and contribute to misinformation, dependence, and overconfidence.

articles.title: iOS 27.3: Three new iPhone features coming soon
articles.summary: iOS 27.3 is currently in beta and packed with new features , here are three that will hit your iPhone when the update launches next month .

articles.title: Veterans' Mental Health Crisis Severity Annotation: Do LLMs Agree More Than Human Experts?
articles.summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable approach for annotating mental health and crisis-related social media content, but their reliability in safety-critical tasks remains unclear.

articles.title: LoRazor: Trimming Adapter Execution for Efficient Multi-LoRA Serving
articles.summary: LoRA offers a parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, supporting multi-user workloads via customized adapters on a shared backbone. However, serving concurrent requests with different adapters introduces substantial computation and memory-management overhead.

articles.title: macOS 27.2.1 Fixes eMudhra Certificate Flaw in Command-Line Tools
articles.summary: Prior to releasing the macOS 27.2.1 update, Apple offered instructions for those who wanted to protect themselves from the compromised eMudhra certificates when using command-line tools, directing users to manually remove the affected root certificates from their Mac's "/etc/ssl/cert.pem" file.

articles.title: Apple Releases macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1
articles.summary: Apple today released macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1, a minor update for the macOS Golden Gate operating system. macOS Golden Gate includes bug fixes and security updates, according to Apple's release notes.

articles.title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2.1 With Bug Fixes
articles.summary: Apple today released iOS 27.2.1, a minor update to the iOS 27 operating system. iOS 27.2.1 comes two weeks after the launch of iOS 27.2.

articles.title: Longtime Linux Developer Steps Down From Some Roles Due To Patch Flood Caused By AI
articles.summary: Linux memory management expert Lorenzo Stoakes at Arm who has been contributing to the kernel since 2014 is stepping away from some reviewership roles within the Linux kernel due to all of the noise from the flood of kernel patches resulting fro AI/LLMs.

articles.title: x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group Posts ACE v2 & AVX10.3 Specs, GCC Patches Ready
articles.summary: While there aren't any processors released yet with AI Compute Extensions (ACE) or AVX10.2 quite yet, the x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group led by AMD and Intel have now posted their ACE v2 and AVX10.3 specifications.

articles.title: openSUSE Tumbleweed Transitioning To Agama Installer
articles.summary: With openSUSE Leap making use of the modern Agama installer developed by SUSE engineers, the rolling-release openSUSE Tumbleweed is now preparing to make the same transitioning in replacing the YaST Installer.

articles.title: RPM v6 Format Approved For Fedora 46, ThinLTO Flag Rejected
articles.summary: With Fedora 45 having shipped last week, developers are turning more of their attention to Fedora 46 that will debut by the end of next April.
